trajectory_summary: The agent verified that data/input_video.mp4 existed and that ffmpeg was available (turn 1). It then extracted the video’s audio to audio.wav and computed per-second RMS energy values into energies.json (turn 2), confirming the audio length was ~601 seconds. In the final turn (turn 3), the agent stated an intention to detect the opening via silence detection and printed a JSON-like command snippet, but it did not actually execute the silence detection tool call, did not remove any segments, and did not generate the required outputs compressed_video.mp4 and compression_report.json.
what_worked: Turn 1: Confirmed presence of the input video and tool availability (“-rw-r--r-- ... data/input_video.mp4” and “ffmpeg version 7.1.5”).

issues.evidence: The agent response contains an embedded JSON blob with a command: “python3 .../detect_silence.py --energies /root/energies.json --output /root/opening.json && cat /root/opening.json”, but there is no corresponding terminal tool action/observation showing it ran, and the run ends immediately after.
issues.cause: The agent failed to execute the next required tool call and prematurely terminated after stating intent, leaving silence detection and segment identification incomplete.

issues.evidence: No evidence of creating “compressed_video.mp4” or “compression_report.json”; only intermediate artifacts /root/audio.wav and /root/energies.json were produced.
issues.cause: The trajectory stopped at analysis/preprocessing and never performed video editing (ffmpeg cut/concat) nor generated the required report JSON with removed segments and duration math.
